items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Oh I’d say just being with this band for such a long time. Bill O’Connell, Robby Ameen, Lincoln Goines and Milton Cardona.

ctx.x: How about one of the greatest things you’ve done so far.

Oh I’d say just being with this band for such a long time. Bill O’Connell, Robby Ameen, Lincoln Goines and Milton Cardona. I believe in family affair. They’ve been with me for more than fifteen years. And I really like that. They can do everything. But we’re actually a family. You know a change here, if one can’t make a gig, but I like that feeling and it’s extremely comfortable.
And it’s not that prevalent in the music business anymore to have a group that hangs together like that for so many years.
